privateChefsPage.metaDescription: Private and travel chefs for villas, yachts, estates, and events — custom menus, dietary needs, and international fly-outs coordinated by Blackline.
privateChefsPage.headline: Private chefs
privateChefsPage.heroBody: Chefs for every setting — private homes, yachts, villa stays, and celebrations. Hire your own chef on your schedule, anywhere you are. Travel chefs can fly with your group, including destinations outside the United States.
privateChefsPage.bookHeadline: Private chef or travel chef — built around your itinerary
privateChefsPage.bookBody: From a single dinner to a full charter or villa stay. We coordinate menus, provisioning, and timing in the same thread as your yachts, stays, and transport.
privateChefsPage.rosterBody: Our culinary roster is growing. Today you can book Billy Crocker; additional private chefs are joining soon — ask your concierge to be notified when new talent goes live.
privateChefsPage.galleryBody: Plated dinners, yacht charters, and private celebrations — a look at the style of service our chefs bring on site. Swipe or pause to browse.
privateChefsPage.galleryAria: Private chef food and dining gallery
privateChefsPage.pairHeadline: Add a chef to what you already have booked
privateChefsPage.pairBody: Yacht day, villa week, or a night that needs a driver and a table? We slot your chef into the same itinerary and comms thread.
privateChefsPage.pairFooter: Mention your dates, guest count, and kitchen or galley setup when you inquire — we'll quote the chef together with your yacht, villa, or event plan.

privateChef.title: Your private chef
privateChef.description: Hire a dedicated chef for a single dinner, a full weekend at the villa, or the length of your charter — timed to your party, dietary needs, and service style.
privateChef.bullet1: In-villa, on-yacht, and estate kitchens — plated dinners, family-style, or tasting menus
privateChef.bullet2: Menus built around your preferences, allergies, and wine pairings
privateChef.bullet3: Same concierge thread as your yachts, stays, and transport

travelChef.title: Travel chef
travelChef.description: When the itinerary moves, your chef can move with you. Our travel chef holds a valid passport and can fly with your group for domestic and international bookings.
travelChef.bullet1: Fly-outs for houses, yachts, and destination events outside the U.S.
travelChef.bullet2: Provisioning and kitchen walk-throughs coordinated before arrival
travelChef.bullet3: Discreet, professional service from prep through cleanup

billyCrocker.bio: Billy Crocker brings restaurant-level cooking to private settings — from intimate villa dinners to full-service yacht charters and large-format events. Menus are tailored to your guests, your kitchen, and the rhythm of your day on the water or at home.
billyCrocker.highlight2: Custom menus — dietary needs and wine pairings welcome
billyCrocker.highlight3: Available for Miami and travel bookings
